public_rationale: The claim has an understandable arithmetic basis: a roughly $4 billion server estimate compared with a later $3.7 billion revenue expectation. But the July revenue range crossed the server estimate, and later reporting summarized by Epoch puts inference expenses substantially lower. The accessible records do not reconcile those estimates or establish complete coverage of free-user serving costs. They therefore do not settle the full-year comparison.
limitations: The original expense report could not be read.
Accessible sources largely repeat estimates from undisclosed financial records.
This assessment does not equate total losses or training expenses with inference-server expenses.
